NEW round-2 finding: the barrier design accepts an absent condition as ready for ALL children. For a child the set has just spec-bumped whose RBG controller has not yet reconciled (post-upgrade bootstrap window), no barrier exists yet, so the set can spend the next budget slot on stale capacity — the producer invariant does not cover that window because the producer has not run since the spec bump. One-sentence fix: accept absence only for children not yet updated in the current rollout (e.g. groupset-revision label still currentRevision).
